axList.name: FIXED BROWSERS (DORMANT)

savedAgentExtra:
Company browsers on the rented server
The rented server isn't connected yet —
Settings → Company browsers
.

Each browser keeps its own sign-in to the tool, so sign each one in once: press Sign in to the tool, open it, sign in to the tool inside it with the company account, then press Done. Nobody can be given that browser meanwhile.
